1.consolidated_definition: art. Arte corporal en el que el artista utiliza su propio cuerpo como principal materia de expresión. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. El hombre de trazados mágicos asegura que el body art es materia fundamental en los grandes desfiles de moda de la actualidad. El body art es un estilo que se enmarca dentro del arte conceptual
1.en_consolidated_definition: Body art: A physical art form in which the artist utilizes their own body as the primary medium of expression. This term is a direct loanword from English and is frequently used. The man of magical designs claims that body art is a fundamental element in major fashion parades currently taking place. Body art is a style that falls within the realm of conceptual art.
